I am farming maize on this small rented plot here in Mbeya. The rains are usually good in our area, so I will not need to irrigate. I want a good harvest because we depend on this maize for food, so I will buy a little fertilizer like DAP and urea even though money is tight, and I will try to use improved seed since neighbors say it gives more cobs. I will do most of the work myself with my family, but during weeding and harvest I may hire one or two people for a few days.
